title: Gambling on the Little League World Series? Sports bettors have gone too far
summary: We need a complete cultural reset, because there are actually sports betting providers that let people gamble on Little League World Series (LLWS) outcomes. Amanda Silberling is a senior writer at TechCrunch covering the intersection of technology and culture.
